name: opencord-selfhost

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.start: node scripts/ensure-build.mjs && npm run start -w server

description: Self-hosted real-time community chat with text, voice, video, moderation, and instance administration.
author: Harukai33
